title: Robert Maxwell gatekeeping science via Pergamon Press

tellings.quote: And then you have Glenn Maxwell's father, Robert Maxwell, who's a triple agent, uh, MI6, KGB, Mossad, gatekeeping scientific discoveries through his control of journal publications via Pergaman Press.
Robert Maxwell’s work as a double agent for both MI6 and the KGB at the height of the Cold War made him very useful when, sometime in the late 1970s, he was also recruited by the Mossad.

Then, as a gatekeeper, he selectively suppressed or sequestered from the public sphere of establishment techno-scientific R&D any revolutionary and destabilizing information – including defense-related research with military applications.
It was also, not coincidentally, the location of the so-called “Throne of Satan” mentioned in the Book of Revelation

plain: Robert Maxwell, the father of Ghislaine Maxwell, was secretly an agent for British intelligence (MI6), Soviet intelligence (the KGB) and Israeli intelligence (the Mossad), and he used his control of Pergamon Press, a publisher of scientific journals, to keep groundbreaking discoveries away from the public. That is what the researcher and philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels, without naming where he learned it. He makes the same case in his own essay Ocean Outlaw: A Portrait of Ghislaine Maxwell, published on 29 July 2025, which says Maxwell worked "as a double agent for both MI6 and the KGB" before being recruited by the Mossad in the late 1970s, and that "as a gatekeeper, he selectively suppressed or sequestered" revolutionary research, "including defense-related research with military applications."
